CustomMetadata.label: Account New Account Creation Alert - After Insert

values.value: Migrated from Account_After_Save_Flow (after-save, create only via source ISNEW() guard - now expressed as after-insert-only context instead of an in-flow check): sends the Account.New_Account_Creation_Alert email alert when the running user's Price_Book_Region__c includes both NA and CSA. Order bumped from 10 to 30 when ATFE_CreateCaseForAccount/ATFE_SendChatterMessage were migrated, to preserve the platform's real order of execution (after-insert Apex triggers run before after-save record-triggered flows).
